title: Mixed reasoning — 10 questions
note: Existing EkGuru sample questions, not a previous official exam. Mixed test Q6 is ungraded because its source relationship is ambiguous.

source.label: Existing repository practice material — not independently verified official key

questions.text: Agar CAT ko 3-1-20 likha jata hai, to DOG ko kaise likhenge?
questions.explanation: CAT = C(3), A(1), T(20). Isi tarah DOG = D(4), O(15), G(7).
jis tarah pustak ke panne hote hain, usi tarah seedhi ke dande (rungs) hote hain.

questions.text: Inme se alag (odd one out) kaun sa hai?
questions.explanation: 16, 25 aur 36 pure varg hain (4², 5², 6²), 42 varg nahi hai.

questions.text: Ek vyakti 3 km uttar (north) chalta hai, phir 4 km poorab (east). Shuruaat se uski seedhi doori kitni hai?
questions.explanation: 3 aur 4 ke beech samkon (90°) hai, isliye seedhi doori = √(3² + 4²) = 5 km.

questions.text: P, Q ka pita hai aur Q, R ki behen hai. To R, P ki kya hai?
questions.explanation: Given that Q is R's sister does not determine R's gender. The source key incorrectly assumes R is female.
questions.notice: Ungraded: the provided relationship is insufficient to determine R's gender.

questions.explanation: 11, 13, 17, 19, 23 lagatar abhajya sankhyayen hain; agla prime 29 hai.

questions.text: 20 vidyarthiyon ki ek pankti me Sunita baayein se 7ve sthan par hai. Dayein se uska sthan kya hoga?
questions.explanation: dayein se sthan = kul + 1 – baayein se sthan = 20 + 1 – 7 = 14.
jis tarah doctor hospital me kaam karta hai, teacher school me.

questions.text: Agar MONDAY ko NPOEBZ likha jata hai, to SUNDAY ko kaise likhenge?
questions.explanation: har akshar ek aage badhta hai: S→T, U→V, N→O, D→E, A→B, Y→Z.
